# Passkey Glossary

[A](#A) | [B](#B) | [C](#C) | [D](#D) | [E](#E) | [F](#F) | [G](#G) | [H](#H) | [I](#I) | [L](#L) | [M](#M) | [N](#N) | [O](#O) | [P](#P) | [R](#R) | [S](#S) | [U](#U) | [W](#W)

A

**Access code** - A unique set of alphanumeric characters used by a specific attendee type to gain access to the booking website.

**Acknowledgment Number** - An alphanumeric identifier generated by Passkey after a reservation record is created. The identifier is listed in the guests’ acknowledgment email and is used to reference a hotel reservation within Passkey. This acknowledgment number is _not_ the hotel confirmation number. That number is generated separately by the hotel. The last digit of an acknowledgment number refers to the occupant position in the reservation (e.g. 0 = primary guest, 1 = one additional guest, 2 = two additional guests, 3 = three additional guests)

**Acquirer** - A financial institution that maintains agreements for the purpose of charging credit cards.

**Actualized** - Room nights stayed and paid for.

**Add-on** - A feature that allows additional hotel items or services to be sold during the online or call center booking process. Examples include breakfast, rollaway, early check-in, late checkout, or spa services.

**Affiliate** - An additional organization [associated to an event in Passkey](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Managing-Affiliates-in-Passkey). Users of the affiliated organization will have access to view and manage the event based on their existing user account permissions.

**Allocate** - A Passkey feature that supports the process of assigning inventory to a specific sub-block based on [sub-block request specifications](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Managing-Sub-Block-Requests-in-Passkey).

**Amenities** - Added features and services that a hotel may provide, such as internet access, in-room movie rentals, or health clubs.

**ARI** - Stands for Availability, Rates, and Inventory. It is an [integration](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Understanding-the-ARI-Integration-in-Passkey) between a hotel’s distribution or rate management system and Passkey. It helps automate upsell opportunities with inventory over and above the contracted group block.

**Attendee type** - A specific event delegate designated in Passkey for the purposes of controlling inventory, rates, and business rules.

**Attrition** - A clause included in a hotel contract indicating the number of room nights that must be actualized to avoid financial penalties.

**Authorization** - The first step in the credit card charging process. Authorization is an electronic request sent through various parties to approve or decline. This will create a temporary transaction on a card holder’s statement.

B

**Base room type** - The rate of a specific room used as a comparison point for determining and tracking upsell.

**Bell Curve** - The room block per night, expressed as a percentage of the peak night. The distribution of inventory is calculated by dividing the amount of inventory on each night by the amount of inventory on peak night.

**Booking website** - A [customized event-specific website](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/The-Complete-Passkey-Booking-Site-Experience) that allows attendees to book rooms for any hotels participating in the event.

**Bundle** - A feature that allows specific parameters to be pre-established and applied during the event creation process. Think of it as an event template.

C

**Campaign** - A marketing or notification email sent to attendees and planners.

**Cap rules** - Provide hotel users with control over [how inventory is managed and sold](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/What-are-the-inventory-cap-rules-in-Passkey).

**Charge Back** - A process to allow a card holder to dispute a charge.

**Citywide event** - A group created and managed by a Passkey licensee who is not a hotel, such as a corporate event planner, Convention & Visitors Bureau (CVB), third-party planner, or sports organization. Citywide events can have one or more participating hotels.

**Citywide organizer** - A type of Passkey user who is not a hotel representative. Examples of Citywide organizers include corporate event planners, Convention & Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), third-party planners, or sports organizations. Citywide organizers who have a Passkey license can create single or multi-hotel events known as Citywide events.

**Close Date - Call Center** - After this date and time, call center forms can no longer be used to make new reservations and edit or cancel existing ones in an event.

**Close Date - Event** - After this date and time, new reservations, changes, and cancellation can no longer be processed by any booking method within Passkey and should be referred directly to the hotel.

**Close Date - Web** - After this date and time, the booking website can no longer be used to make new reservations and edit or cancel existing ones in an event.

**Commerce** - A feature for citywide organizations only, which allows deposits, processing, and cancellation fees to be charged on the guests' credit cards.

**Commission** - A percentage of the booked and actualized revenue charged to hotels in return for housing services.

**Concierge Floor** - A special level in a hotel with upgraded services and amenities. The level may be keyed off from the general public. Rooms on these floors are offered at a higher rate.

**Confirmed** - A reservation status indicating all room nights have been captured from availability.

**Credit Card Authorization Form** - Allows the use of another’s credit card or allows the hotel to charge the credit card before the guests arrive. This form is used when the guest does not have the credit card with them and would like to charge the entire stay on the credit card, or when the guest would like to use someone else’s credit card to pay for their hotel reservation. Forms are hotel-specific.

**Current Block** - An editable inventory row to store the night-by-night room block created by a licensee.

**Cutoff Date - Event** - The final date the event organizer will have sole control of the Event Home inventory page. The following day, each hotel can co-manage inventory, rates, and settings for their hotel in the Passkey event.

**Cutoff Date - Hotel** - In a Hotel Direct event, this is the contracted date for the hotel to stop receiving reservations and when a group’s room and block negotiated rates expire.

**CVV** - Credit Card Verification Value. The CVV is an anti-fraud security feature to help verify the purchaser is in possession of their card.

D

**Dashboard** - A password-secured website for event planners designed to display event data for quick analysis and provide reservation management tools.

**DBA** - Abbreviation for "Doing Business As." The DBA is displayed as a description on a card holder’s credit card statement.

**Delegate** - An event attendee.

**Delegate Profile** - A Contacts list of attendee names and addresses that can be selected and pulled into a reservation as a method to expedite the booking process. This feature is available in the [Multi-Room Booking tool](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Using-the-Multi-Room-Booking-Tool) only and is specific to sub-block groups.

E

**Earned Comp** - A type of concession found in a hotel contract allowing the event planner to earn complimentary room nights based on inventory sold and actualized. Earned comp policies are stated as a ratio such as 1/50.

**Event Code** - Is a unique ID used by the RegLink API, which gives access to the appropriate inventory assigned to an attendee type.

**Event ID** - Is a unique code assigned to each Passkey event.

**Extended Stay** - Reservation that includes one or more nights outside the contracted room block.

**Event Organizer** - Passkey licensee who owns and manages a Citywide event in Passkey.

F

**Final Reported** - An [inventory row](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Entering-the-Final-Reported-Pickup-for-an-Event) that stores the night-by-night actualized inventory.

**Free-Sell** - Inventory made available from the Room Type level to any attendee type where this option is enabled. Free-Sell inventory is sold in the order that it was booked.

G

**Group Booking Workflow** - A feature that streamlines the process of booking multiple rooms in one session.

**Group Booking Contact** - Name and address details for the contact that created multiple reservations using the Group Booking Workflow. The booking contact may or may not be included on the reservation.

[**GroupLink**](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Setting-Up-GroupLink-for-a-Passkey-Event) - An integration feature that facilitates reservation transfers between Passkey and a hotel's property management or central reservation system.

[**GroupMasterLink**](https://support.cvent.com/Passkey/s/communityarticle/About-GroupMasterLink) - An integration feature that allows the transfer of block details from a hotel’s Sales & Catering, Property Management, or Central Reservations system to Passkey.

**Guaranteed** - A feature that allows you to mark a block of rooms as reserved for a specific attendee type.

**Guarantee Type** - A method of collateral to secure a reservation. It can be used to assess penalties in the event of a [no-show](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Passkey-Glossary#N) or cancellation. This is also known as a Payment Plan.

**Guest Fees** - The cost charged by a hotel for each additional guest occupying a room.

H

**Hotel Confirmation Number** - A code generated by a hotel to confirm a reservation. It should _not_ be confused with the Passkey acknowledgement number. Hotels with direct connectivity will automatically send back hotel confirmation numbers to Passkey. Hotels without connectivity can manually enter their confirmations number into RezHub which will be available through Passkey.

**Hotel Direct Event** - An event created by a Passkey licensed hotel.

I

**In Waiting** - A label used in several Passkey reports to refer to inventory nights on a reservation that are waitlisted.

**Inbound Reservations** - Reservations originating in a hotel’s system and transferring _to_ Passkey through an integration.

**Incidentals** - Optional charges that a hotel guest may need to pay for using hotel services such as movies, room service, dry-cleaning, or phone calls. Incidental charges are not included in the room rate.

**Inventory Request** - A feature used by an organization to acquire inventory from a property for a specific event.

L

**Library** - A collection of elements that can be created in the hotel or organizer profile to aid in the event setup process. Think of them as building blocks you can use to create your Passkey events or event templates known as bundles.

**Link Gateway** - The processor used by the Gateway to communicate transaction data.

M

**Master Acknowledgement** - A reference code that ties together individual reservations within a [group booking](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Enabling-Group-Bookings-in-Passkey). You can use it to [locate existing group bookings](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/How-do-I-search-for-a-specific-Passkey-reservation#Edit) within your events.

**Merchant** - Any business entity that is authorized to accept credit cards for goods and services.

**Merchant Account Processing** - A feature for Citywide organizations only, which allows deposits, processing, and cancellation fees to be charged on the guests' credit cards.

**MID** - Merchant Identification.

**Multi-Room Booking (MRB)** - A reservation management tool that allows you to quickly make, modify, or cancel one or more reservations in a Passkey event.

N

**Non-Licensed Hotel** - A hotel that does not hold a Passkey license but is given complimentary access to Passkey for Citywide events they are added to by a Passkey-licensed event organizer.

**No Shows** - Reservations that were canceled after the reservation arrival date.

O

**Occupancy** - The number of people staying in a room.

**Open Date and Time - Event** - From this date, at the specified time, the event is open for reservations.

**Open Date and Time - Web** - From this date, at the specified time, the event website is open for reservations.

**Open Date and Time - Call Center** - From this date, at the specified time, the call center is open for reservations.

**Organizer** - A Passkey licensee that is not a hotel.

**Original Block** - Inventory row that displays the room block entered during the event creation process.

**Outbound Reservations** - Passkey bookings that transfer to a hotel system through integration.

P

**Pace** - Used to demonstrate the flow of booking activity over a period of time. In reports, the pace provides the number of room nights booked during a specific interval.

**Peak Night** - The event night that holds the highest amount of inventory.

**Pending** - A reservation status indicating that one or more room nights are waitlisted.

**Per Key** - The number of rooms in a hotel.

**Pickup** - Inventory consumed and confirmed into reservations.

**Primary Guest** - A room occupant designated as the reservation lead. The first person entered on a reservation will default as the primary guest. If there are multiple occupants per room, any occupant may be given the primary guest designation.

**Primary Inventory** - A feature that allows a hotel to add non-contracted inventory to Passkey for consumption by any event attendees during a specific interval. Primary inventory is generally used for upsell purposes.

**Promo Cube** - A website feature that allows event and destination highlights to be included during the website booking process.

R

**Rack Rate** - A hotel’s published rate for available rooms. Group rates are typically discounted from this rate.

**Reason Code 71** - Processing code that indicates the authorization was declined.

**Reason Code 72** - Processing code that indicates no authorization because invalid information was provided.

**Reason Code 73** - Processing code that indicates an expired card.

**Reason Code 96** - Processing code that indicates the transaction exceeded the amount limit.

**RegLink** - A feature allowing online registration systems to use standard API to pass an attendee from the event registration website to the event’s Passkey housing website.

**Reservation Access Date** - On this date, hotels participating in a Citywide event will start receiving [hotel reservation notification emails](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Updating-a-Hotel-s-Reservation-Contact-Email-in-Passkey), will be able to [run specific reports](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Which-Passkey-report-should-I-run) such as the Room List or Delegate report, and will gain access to reservations in [RezHub](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Using-Passkey-RezHUB). By default, the reservation access date for a participating hotel is set as the day after [cutoff](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Key-Dates-and-Times-in-Passkey-Events?is_article=true&lang=en_US&searchFor=reservation%20access%20date#PK_Cutoff_date). You can, however, manually [change the reservation access date](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Key-Dates-and-Times-in-Passkey-Events#PK_Hotel_inv_dates) for a participating hotel.

**RezHub** - A [reservation transfer tool](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Using-Passkey-RezHUB) that allows hotels to securely retrieve bookings for Passkey events.

**Rooming Lists** - A list of individual guest names and reservation details for each room confirmed in a room block.

**Room Revenue** - The value of all active reservations rates multiplied by nights, plus any guest fees. Taxes are not included in the revenue.

**Room List Manager (RLM)** - A reservation tool that allows a licensee to map and import a rooming list spreadsheet into Passkey to automatically make reservations.

**Room Night** - A single night within a room block or reservation.

**Room Type** - A room category or configuration within a hotel that has specific inventory and rates.

**Run of House (ROH)** - The best available room upon check-in. Run of House inventory typically excludes any specific room type such as club level rooms or concierge level rooms

S

**Sell Status** - A setting that controls the ability to sell inventory for specific scenarios.

**Settlement** - The second step in the credit card charging process. A settlement refers to all parties reconciling the money and getting paid. This will create a posting on the card holder’s credit card statement

**Share With** - A room that is shared by two or more guests.

**Sister Property** - A hotel associated to one or more additional properties for the purposes of hosting group business.

**SmartAlert** - A feature allowing fixed reports and communications to be sent for an event.

**Snapshot Report** - Any report with data recorded as of 11:59:59 P.M, the previous day.

**SPORG** - Stands for Sister Property Organization. It is an association of several individual properties for the purposes of hosting group business.

**Sub-Block** - A room type that is associated with an attendee type. A sub-block may be used to control inventory, rates, and reporting.

**Sub-Block Group** - A feature that allows a designated planner to be associated to one or more attendee types. [Sub-Block Groups](https://support.cvent.com/s/communityarticle/Managing-Sub-Block-Groups-in-Passkey-Events) can have assigned contacts with access to a specific planner dashboard. This dashboard allows them to manage reservations for the associated attendee types.

**Sub-Block Request** - A feature used by Sub-Block Group contacts to request inventory.

U

**Unassigned** - Event inventory row uses when no inventory is allocated to a sub-block or used through Free-Sell.

**Unconfirmed** - A reservation status indicating that required information is missing. This status only shows up for reservations created through the Multi-Room Booking tool.

**Upsell** - A booking website feature that allows guests to choose a more expensive room type after they initially selected a room type at a lower cost within the same hotel.

W

**Waiting Room** - A feature supported through a third-party vendor that temporarily redirects guests to an alternate page when there is heavy booking website traffic.

**Waitlist** - The status of a reservation when the guest selected a room type that has no available inventory at the time of the booking.
